Sebuah tabel invoice memiliki 10000 bari: An invoice table has 10000 rows. A status = 'open' filter returns almost every row, while invoice_id = 108 returns one. Why does having the same B-tree available not automatically make both queries choose an Index Scan?
Menjelaskan bahwa B-tree mendukung penca: Explain that a B-tree supports equality searches, ranges, and certain orderings through its ordered keys.
Menghitung selectivity sebagai proporsi: Calculate selectivity as the proportion of matching rows and connect it to access choices that remain estimates.
Membedakan kandidat Index Scan, Seq Scan: Distinguish an Index Scan, Seq Scan, or Bitmap path candidate from runtime evidence that requires a real plan and measurement.
B-tree menyimpan urutan yang bisa dicari: A B-tree stores a searchable order
B-tree menyimpan nilai key dalam struktu: A B-tree stores key values in an ordered structure, so PostgreSQL can search equality conditions such as `invoice_id = 108`, ranges such as `due_date >= DATE '2026-10-01'`, or part of an order for `ORDER BY invoice_id`. This does not mean every query that names an indexed column must use the index. The planner still evaluates how many rows match, how many heap pages must be read, and whether the result order can help. A B-tree is also not a general solution for every text pattern or function; the predicate, operator, collation, and index form must match.
Primary key atau UNIQUE biasanya memilik: A primary key or UNIQUE constraint usually has a B-tree index needed to protect identity, while extra indexes are workload decisions. In the commerce example, a unique `invoice_id` gives a very narrow target. A `status` column with only a few values may still deserve an index for a particular workload, but that key is not automatically selective. Separate an index's role as a search structure from the planner's decision to use it for one query.
Di lesson ini selectivity ditulis sebaga: In this lesson, selectivity is written as `matching_rows / total_rows`: 0.0001 means only a very small fraction of rows match, while 0.8400 means most rows match. A smaller number usually means a more selective predicate. Selectivity is not a moral label for whether a query is good or bad; a popular status filter can still be useful even when it is not selective, and a selective filter can be costly when heap pages are scattered or statistics are wrong. The term helps us ask how much data must be fetched instead of guessing an operator from an index name.
Seq Scan dapat masuk akal ketika predica: A Seq Scan can make sense when a predicate takes a large share of the table, the table is small, or an index read followed by many heap lookups is estimated to cost more. An Index Scan can be a candidate when the target is narrow and the key matches. A Bitmap path can be a compromise when many rows match but the index still helps gather pages. The worked fixture stores only authored numbers and candidate labels; it does not run the planner, read statistics, or measure I/O.
Kandidat akses bukan bukti performa: An access candidate is not performance evidence
Saat membaca rencana nyata, mulai dari q: When reading a real plan, start with the query and predicate, then inspect estimated rows, cost, operators, and relevant configuration. Do not conclude that an Index Scan is faster just because its name sounds targeted. Cache, row width, value distribution, visibility, parallelism, and output shape can change the choice. `EXPLAIN` without `ANALYZE` gives a plan and estimates; `EXPLAIN ANALYZE` measures execution and is therefore outside this prediction fixture.
Kesimpulan yang aman dari Dataset I1 ada: The safe conclusion from Dataset I1 is that `invoice_id` is highly selective and therefore an Index Scan is worth considering, `status = 'open'` takes almost the whole table and therefore a Seq Scan is worth considering, and the date range is in the middle. This is not a contract that PostgreSQL will choose those labels on every database. Before adding or removing an index, establish the workload, the queries actually used, and plan changes with appropriate evidence.

Urutan key menentukan jalur awal: Key order determines the starting path
Indeks B-tree multikolom `(student_id, d: A multicolumn B-tree `(student_id, due_date)` orders first by student_id and then by due_date within each student_id value. A predicate restricting student_id can therefore open a path for a due_date range or ordering. A query restricting only due_date has no leading equality/range on student_id; the same index may still have limited uses, but it must not be described as if the whole tree is immediately cut at due_date. Key order should follow the workload shape, not simply put every column into one index.
Untuk laporan `WHERE student_id = 7 ORDE: For a report `WHERE student_id = 7 ORDER BY due_date`, `(student_id, due_date)` expresses two needs at once: the student group is narrowed and rows within the group are ordered. An illustrative DDL could be `CREATE INDEX lesson_invoice_student_due_open ON pg_temp.lesson_commerce_invoices (student_id, due_date) INCLUDE (invoice_id, amount) WHERE status = 'open';`; the fixture does not execute this DDL. If the workload mainly searches due_date across all students, `(due_date, student_id)` or another design may fit better. This lesson gives a design hypothesis and does not measure a plan; cardinality, LIMIT, and the complete predicate still need checking on a real database.
INCLUDE menambah payload, bukan key penc: INCLUDE adds payload, not a search key
`INCLUDE (invoice_id, amount)` menaruh k: `INCLUDE (invoice_id, amount)` puts payload columns in index leaves without making them part of the search-key order. An INCLUDE column does not extend the ability to search by that column and does not change the leading-column rule. It can help a query that only needs to return payload after the key finds candidates, but index size and maintenance cost still grow. INCLUDE also does not guarantee an index-only scan: PostgreSQL still needs visibility information from the visibility map and may fetch the heap for pages that are not all-visible.
Karena itu istilah covering index harus: The term covering index should therefore be read as a possible index-only path for a particular query, not a promise that the heap is never touched. A query asking for a column absent from the key or INCLUDE still needs to fetch it from the heap. Even when every result column is available, visibility, recent changes, and plan conditions can still require a heap visit. The worked table records design reasons, not heap-fetch counts or time.
Partial index bergantung pada implicatio: A partial index depends on implication
Partial index hanya menyimpan row yang m: A partial index stores only rows satisfying its predicate, such as `WHERE status = 'open'`. It most clearly helps a query whose predicate can be proved to imply `status = 'open'`, so the planner knows rows outside the index are not needed. A query with the literal `status = 'open'` gives an understandable relationship. A query with `status = $1` generally cannot be proved for every parameter value when the plan is made, so use of this partial index must not be promised. Text equality, casts, and expression form also need checking.
Partial index bukan cara menyembunyikan: A partial index is not a way to hide a constraint need or make status correct automatically. Its predicate bounds index membership; it is not global validation that every open invoice has a particular value. If a query lacks enough conditions, rows that exist only outside the partial index still need consideration. Good design writes the query contract, key order, payload, and predicate together, then checks the plan with the relevant version, statistics, and parameters.

Baca lebih cepat memiliki tagihan write: Faster reads have a write bill
Setiap indeks tambahan adalah struktur y: Every additional index is a structure to maintain when a new row arrives or an indexed-key value changes. Maintenance can add CPU work, page splits, WAL, storage, vacuum work, and write time. The size is not always a simple function of index count: an update to a non-indexed column may take a different path, HOT may or may not be available, and row shape and fillfactor also matter. Therefore write amplification in this lesson is used to reason about cost direction, not to promise a universal multiplier.
Manfaat read juga spesifik terhadap work: Read benefits are also workload-specific. A targeted index for a frequent, selective invoice query may be worth keeping, while three indexes covering nearly the same keys may pay repeated maintenance without adding a meaningful read path. The worked table calls `authored_relative_units` a teaching number so decisions can be compared; it is not a measurement of WAL, latency, file size, or PostgreSQL throughput.
Beban index perlu dilihat sebagai trade-: Index burden must be viewed as a trade-off
Evaluasi index sebaiknya menghubungkan q: Index evaluation should connect the queries served, frequency and selectivity, table size, insert/update/delete patterns, ordering needs, and operating cost. A partial index can reduce the rows maintained when its predicate fits, but it must not be used as a reason to claim that every query will find it. A very large index can also add cache and storage pressure. Remove redundancy only after understanding the queries and constraints that depend on it; similar appearance is not enough to conclude that removal is safe.
Perubahan pada indexed column dapat memb: A change to an indexed column may require changing an index entry. A change to a non-indexed column can sometimes use a HOT update, but HOT depends on storage conditions and must not be presented as a guarantee. Vacuum and visibility remain part of the lifecycle. This lesson does not run a before/after benchmark; it teaches the evidence list to collect when making a production decision.
Constraint index bukan sekadar tuning: A constraint index is not just tuning
Primary key dan UNIQUE memakai mekanisme: Primary keys and UNIQUE constraints use index mechanisms to enforce identity or uniqueness. Write and storage costs are still real, but removing an index that is a constraint arbiter can change correctness, not merely reduce latency. A query that is not visibly read-hot does not cancel a constraint need. Conversely, an extra index created only from a performance guess needs an inspectable workload and evidence. Distinguish `constraint_role = required-correctness` from `optional-tuning` before proposing a change.
Candidate payment-identity mempertahanka: Candidate payment-identity keeps unique `(merchant_id, idempotency_key)` even though the callback table is write-heavy. That constraint prevents duplicate identity within the business scope and must not be treated like an overlapping report index. The final decision still needs query, size, maintenance-window, and observability review. This fixture does not claim that one index count is safe for every deployment or update pattern.

Role constraint menentukan kebutuhan int: The constraint role determines the integrity need. The cost still needs to be accepted and managed, but it must not be removed merely because it is not read-hot.

Belum tepat. Constraint index tetap meng: Not quite. A constraint index still consumes storage and is maintained on writes.
Belum tepat. Query tidak mengubah indeks: Not quite. A query does not turn an ordinary index into a constraint.
Klasifikasikan biaya relatif dan role in: Classify relative cost and index role for read-heavy, write-heavy, overlapping, and identity-constraint workloads.
Gunakan Dataset I3 sebagai skala authore: Use Dataset I3 as an authored scale. `authored_relative_units` is not measured WAL, throughput, or file size; the player assesses trade-offs and correctness role.
Tabel invoice memiliki lookup student_id: An invoice table has a frequently used student_id + due_date lookup and moderate inserts. Which initial design is most defensible?
Satu targeted index candidate, lalu ukur: One targeted index candidate, then measure workload and maintenance before adding another.
Tiga index overlapping langsung, karena: Three overlapping indexes immediately, because every query must have its own index.
Tidak boleh ada index karena semua index: There must be no index because every index slows the system more than its benefit.
Satu desain targeted membuat trade-off l: One targeted design makes the trade-off smaller and assessable. It is still not proof that the plan or throughput will improve.
Benar. Mulai dari workload nyata dan evi: Correct. Start with the real workload and evidence instead of stacking speculative indexes.
Belum tepat. Overlap menambah maintenanc: Not quite. Overlap adds maintenance/storage and needs a different query reason.
Belum tepat. Index dapat bermanfaat untu: Not quite. An index can benefit a read workload; the decision must be based on trade-offs.
Reviewer menemukan tiga index report inv: A reviewer finds three invoice report indexes with nearly the same prefix and payload, but there is a UNIQUE `(merchant_id, idempotency_key)`. What is the safe step?
Hapus semua empat index agar write ampli: Delete all four indexes so write amplification is zero.
Pertahankan unique constraint sebagai co: Keep the unique constraint for correctness, then review report overlap with queries/evidence before changing it.
Hapus unique constraint karena callback: Delete the unique constraint because callbacks are not part of the read workload.
Overlap optional-tuning dan required-cor: Optional-tuning overlap and required-correctness have different consequences. Report redundancy needs evidence, while the unique guard protects identity.
Belum tepat. Menghapus arbiter unique da: Not quite. Removing the unique arbiter can allow duplicate identity and remove correctness.
Benar. Pisahkan review redundancy dari c: Correct. Separate redundancy review from the required constraint.
Belum tepat. Constraint tetap penting wa: Not quite. The constraint remains important even when it is not a read-hot report query.
Aplikasi hanya mengubah kolom non-indexe: An application changes only non-indexed columns. Does a HOT update definitely occur and remove all index maintenance?
Ya, HOT adalah jaminan setiap kali kolom: Yes, HOT is guaranteed whenever a non-indexed column changes.
Tidak ada hubungan; PostgreSQL selalu me: There is no relationship; PostgreSQL always rewrites every index entry.
HOT mungkin membantu bila kondisi storag: HOT may help when storage conditions are met, but it is not a guarantee; do not turn a possibility into a measurement.
HOT dapat menghindari sebagian perubahan: HOT can avoid some index changes under certain conditions, but page space and update details determine the result.
Belum tepat. HOT memiliki prasyarat dan: Not quite. HOT has prerequisites and is not promised for every update.
Belum tepat. HOT justru dapat mengurangi: Not quite. HOT can in fact reduce some index maintenance under suitable conditions.
Benar. Gunakan evidence storage/runtime: Correct. Use storage/runtime evidence if you want to claim HOT or a particular write cost.
Index report jarang dipakai tetapi juga: A report index is rarely used but is also the UNIQUE arbiter for an idempotency key. What is the safe decision?
Anggap tetap optional karena tidak read-: Treat it as optional because it is not read-hot.
Hapus tanpa migrasi karena constraint ha: Delete it without migration because a constraint is only documentation.
Pertahankan atau rancang pengganti yang: Keep it or design a replacement that still enforces uniqueness; the correctness role outweighs simple read optimization.
Index yang mendukung UNIQUE bukan sekada: An index supporting UNIQUE is not merely a query cache. A change must preserve the constraint or explicitly move enforcement.
Belum tepat. Read frequency tidak mengha: Not quite. Read frequency does not remove the need for an identity guard.
Belum tepat. Constraint database adalah: Not quite. A database constraint is enforcement, not passive documentation.
Benar. Bedakan biaya yang harus dikelola: Correct. Separate the cost that must be managed from the correctness guarantee that must be preserved.
Tulis dua sisi keputusan: query read yan: Write both sides of the decision: the read query served and the added write/storage maintenance.
Cari overlap sebelum menambah index, tet: Look for overlap before adding an index, but first check whether an index is a PK or UNIQUE arbiter.
Gunakan kata candidate, authored, atau p: Use words such as candidate, authored, or needs measurement; do not call throughput, WAL, HOT, or latency runtime facts from the fixture.
Reference query mempertahankan empat des: The reference query keeps four designs for comparison: a baseline without a lookup, targeted-report as an optional-tuning candidate, overlapping-three as redundancy needing evidence, and payment-identity as required-correctness. No throughput/storage numbers are measured and no production constraint is changed.
Jelaskan bagaimana index dapat membantu: Explain how an index can help reads while adding write amplification and storage, why overlap needs evidence before removal, and why a UNIQUE or primary-key index should be judged as a correctness role, not only tuning.
Urutan key memulai pencarian dari studen: Key order starts from student_id. Without a leading-column restriction, PostgreSQL 17 may need to scan the entire index to filter due_date; ordering by (student_id, due_date) also does not satisfy a global ORDER BY due_date.
Fixture Commerce memberi contoh konkret:: The Commerce fixture gives a concrete example: invoices 1001 and 1002 are open for student 7 and ordered by due_date; invoice 1006 belongs to the same student and is paid. The student-unpaid query matches the leading key, payload, and literal partial predicate. The due-date-only query does not restrict student_id: filtering may require a full index scan and index order is not global due_date order. The parameterized-status query does not automatically prove the partial predicate because the status value is unknown. These are authored design classifications, not planner or visibility-map observations.
